name: synergy-medical-yoga-monorepo
description: Synergy Medical Yoga full-stack application (Backend, Frontend, Admin)

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm --prefix fontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix fontend install && npm --prefix admin install
